paper.title: Factors in Color Fundus Photographs That Can Be Used by Humans to Determine Sex of Individuals

type: Qualitative comparison, not statistical feature correlation
comparison: Disc shape: qualitative agreement with Discussion. Numeric ovality index must not be interpreted as more oval merely because it is larger.
Disc pallor: not measured; surrounding fundus color measurements differ in region and metric.
RPE pattern: not equivalent to tessellation fundus index. Direction cannot be classified without a defined mapping.
Vasculature: same broad anatomy; prominence is not artery location or angle.
